look_here_first: Look for an erect annual with broad, often opposite lower leaves and many small GREENISH heads in upper branching clusters, not showy daisy flowers. Check whether each head is a compact cluster of tiny florets enclosed by bracts. Distinguish annual Iva annua from ragweeds (Ambrosia): ragweed typically has conspicuous separate terminal pollen-bearing male head clusters and lower seed-bearing female heads, often more deeply lobed leaves. Confirm with mature head/bract and fruit close-ups rather than green color alone.
